title: Notification counts for 40 fictional activity events
method: Synthetic 40-event cohort spans two five-minute windows in one day. Policies yield 40, 2 or 1 sends if all events qualify. Counts exclude essential-alert exceptions and do not measure engagement or delivery success.
alt: Notification counts for 40 fictional activity events. Immediate per event: 40 notifications; Two five-minute digests: 2 notifications; One daily digest: 1 notifications. Illustrative inputs.
